result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken/missing restaurant image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a generic placeholder/broken image icon (overlapping squares) instead of the restaurant's actual image. Other restaurant cards in the app display proper food images.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads correctly or display a fallback image. Verify the image URL and loading logic for this specific restaurant card.
